content: वक्र {%a.%} .²1 Crooked (<ab>fig.</ab> also), bent, curved, winding, tortuous; वक्रः पन्था यदपि भवतः प्रस्थितस्योत्तराशाम् <ls>Me. 27</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 29</ls>. .²2 Roundabout, indirect, evasive, circuitous, equivocal, ambiguous (as a speech); किमेतैर्वक्रभणितैः <ls>Ratn. 2</ls>; वक्रवाक्यरचनारमणीयः … … सुभ्रुवां प्रववृते परिहासः <ls>Śi. 10. 12</ls>; see वक्रोक्ति also. .²3 Curled, curling, crisped (as hair). .²4 Retrograde (as motion). .²5 Dishonest, fraudulent, crooked in disposition. .²6 Cruel, malignant (as a planet); वक्राः स्युः पञ्चषष्ठेऽर्के अतिवक्रा नगाष्टगे . नवमे दशमे चैव जायते सहजा गतिः .. <ls>Jyotistattvam.</ls> .²7 Prosodially long. .{@-क्रः@} .²1 The planet Mars. .²2 The planet Saturn. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the demon Tripura. .²5 A nose. .{@-क्रम्@} .²1 The bend or arm of a river. .²2 Retrograde motion (of a planet). .²3 A form of fracture.
